note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: 1:1 crop reads as horizontal smear across vertical planks; grain is soft and the hstreak injection looks like motion blur.
flags.fix: Lower the hstreak strength and add fine, crisp plank grain along the vertical direction; recheck the 1:1 crop.

flags.problem: Faceted polygon blotches repeat across the panel and a bright synthetic hairline crack appears at 1:1.
flags.fix: Remove the hairline and the faceted stamp noise; keep the rivets and vertical seams from the original.

flags.problem: Thin vertical and horizontal crosshair seam lines cross the pillar area and are visible at 1:1.
flags.fix: Locate the wrap/seam line positions from the upscale and blend them out; recheck tile edges at 1:1.
